comments.author: coinpurse
comments.body_html:
In LoadTraderBase()::ModDatabaseLoader.cs, you get the file path for modFolder/db/04_trader/base.json. In the actual file path its modFolder/db/04_Trader/base.json (capital T in Trader). This is fine for Windows, but causes the server on Linux to throw an exception.

If anyone runs into this issue, renaming the folder to 04_trader should fix the issue.

comments.author: golpotato
comments.body_html:
Rather than attributing it to the mod itself, it’s more accurate to say that the mod’s “magic” facilitated the problem… As Mag Drills levels increase or other reload speed changes occur, excessively fast Mag-of-Holding reload speeds can cause magazine-bullet interaction to fail.

Reloading cannot be stopped during a raid; restarting the game can fix the issue. The temporary solution is to modify the item configuration in MoH.
